family: Actual gate h negative on {0,1,2,4,8,16,32,6,17,40} and one-flip gate J(x)=-h(x xor1); six disjoint identical arbitrary Boolean cores
domain: h chosen input bias a in (0,7/32] or [1/2,25/32]; J input bias p in (0,1/16]; arbitrary finite admissible words. Compact certificates: 128 fixed rational intervals on each h band [1/16,7/32] and [1/2,25/32]. Rare ends are analytic, not sampled inference.
case_count: 256 compact real-parameter intervals; exact gate probability/pivotal polynomials; 12 rational gate profiles at p in {1/32,1/16,1/8,7/32,1/2,25/32}; four direct 12-bit compositions (two gates times AND2/parity2); independent A089 constants review
symmetry: Matching automorphisms only for h; J retains all six separately computed pivotal probabilities, no transitivity shortcut
arithmetic: int/Fraction, exact power and Bernstein polynomial identities; 192-bit 80-term atanh outward logarithms; floating fields display only
